title: Puerto Rican Christmas Coquito
description: A chilled coconut and white rum drink with cinnamon and vanilla for Christmas.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon, plus more for serving
steps: Blend 1 can coconut milk, 1 can cream of coconut, 1 can evaporated milk, 1 can condensed milk, rum, vanilla, and 1 teaspoon cinnamon until smooth.
Pour into a covered pitcher and refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
Stir well before serving. Pour into small glasses and dust with cinnamon. Keep refrigerated between servings.
imageAlt: White coquito in a small glass dusted with cinnamon
